title: todo step config
description: Executes the server-owned plan tools called by the preceding infer step and keeps the plan in the pipeline context.

handled_step.description: Step to branch to after the plan calls of the preceding generation were executed, unless an ask_user question or a client tool call ends the turn instead (usually the infer step that produced them, or the gate after it); the envelope next_step when unset, and always when the generation made no plan call.
